info.title: Viper's Creed
info.synopsis: In un futuro Cyberpunk, dove le megacorporazioni dominano le città rimaste isolate dopo la una guerra mondiale, un gruppo di mercenari di nome Viper, difendono la città da dei mostri meccanici che cercano di entrare nel circuito urbano per distruggerlo. I viper hanno a disposizione moto a tre ruote che hanno la capacità di trasformarsi in automi, anche se solo per un periodo di tempo limitato.

episodes.title: Cyclops
episodes.synopsis: AGS Blademen were deployed to pursue a Megasoma Bugmech en route to Daiva City. The Megasoma puts up a tough offensive against the AQS Maneuver-Blades, nearly forcing the army to intervene after the Blademen had sustained casualties to eliminate the armed Bugmech. One of the Blademan operatives, Saiki Cryde, decides to sacrifice his Manuever-Blade by self-destructing it in order to blow up the Megamsoma taking a section of a highway along with it. In the end, Saiki was forced to give up most of his pay for the highway's repairs despite being able to eliminate the threat.

episodes.title: Unknown
episodes.synopsis: Haruki Oguma, the only son of AGS President Fuyuhiko Oguma, is selected to be an AQS Blademan operative despite his father's wishes for him not do so in order to prove that he can protect Fort Daiva City and its people by himself and not by his father's influence. His presence brings some doubt to the other veteran Blademen, including Saiki, due to his ties with the company's president. During an AGS operation to hunt down Gellis Bugmechs, Haruki receives orders to immediately withdraw. Despite this, he disobeys them and hunts down the Gellis with Saiki accompanying the young Blademan as they were able to defeat squads of Gellises on their own.

episodes.title: Shot
episodes.synopsis: Saiki gets blamed for the killing of a local man after he had fired on the Blademan in an anti-Bugmech operation that resulted in civilian casualties. In the course of hiding from the police, Saiki is given shelter by an old friend, from his war days, named Doc while Kariya tries to obtain information covertly on the culprit responsible for framing him. During her investigation, she finds out that one of their own could have been the real shooter in the death of the homeless man and framed Saiki in his place. She enlists the assistance of Haruki to help her locate the culprit while Norma and Rudra are on the scene to capture the culprit for monetary gains.

episodes.title: Sorceress
episodes.synopsis: After a young elementary school student was kidnapped from a monorail by an unknown man, Norma works alone to provide ransom money to save her from her captors. However, the car used to transport her was planted with a Ticker bomb by an Acromantis Bugmech. When Norma was wounded by a gunman in the outskirts of Daiva City, she reveals to Kariya and Saiki that the girl's name was Marie and she was her only daughter during their time together as homeless refugees after escaping from war before she gave her up to adoption due to lack of necessities needed to provide care for her and was recruited as a Blademan operative in order to ensure that Norma can provide it to her daughter.

episodes.title: Grim Reaper
episodes.synopsis: Police arrest Rudra for being the main suspect responsible for the assassination of a public official by using a sniper rifle-armed Maneuver-Blade mecha despite him being present with the other AGS personnel during an anti-terrorist operation. Being released from police custody with the intervention of AGS officials, the blonde man has surmised that the main culprit responsible for the attack before his detention on the official was someone from his past. He finds out that Maya, an ex-war buddy of his from his World War III days as an anti-government guerrilla after an attempt was announced on President Oguma.

episodes.title: Golem
episodes.synopsis: When Haruki invites Saiki, Kariya and Gharib to eat with him in a local Asian ethnic restaurant for dinner, the four AGS personnel find out that the owner is subjected to a huge debt. However, Gharib finds out that the one sent to collect the debt on the restaurant was an ex-soldier who had trained under him during Gharib's day as a military officer when the soldier's hands were disabled after the bald man saved his life by shooting the armed landmine. Determined to save the restaurant and do something about his life once more, Gharib decides to help the owner's daughter to move on from the past and assist her in her cooking skills.

episodes.title: Riot
episodes.synopsis: An anti-AGS riot turns sour when Rudra threatened to use force to settle it after a bombing incident was credited to Hounds, a group of supposedly anti-PMC terrorists when mainstream news media claim that they were simply just extremists not out to kill. Haruki has doubts over the claims and visits Ulla Chiaki, the main leader of Hounds and a friend of Haruki who tells him that he and the others didn't plant the bomb in the mall. However, public pressure over pro and anti-Hound groups has forced AGS to conduct an anti-terrorist mission. The Blademen were deployed to locate them, only for their systems to be hacked in order to give Ulla and the others the chance to escape.

episodes.title: Eden
episodes.synopsis: Theresia Strauss, AGS official, suggests to Fuyuhiko Oguma that Haruki was the most likely culprit for yesterday's failed mission. Doubt begins to surface from within the Blademen unit when Norma suggests that a double agent was responsible for their recent anti-Hounds operation. Haruki encounters Ulla, but is seen speaking with Theresia in an abandoned church. He later returns to AGS headquarters and finds a hidden garden of flowers created by his father to honor his late mother. Haruki was assassinated in the building after his encounter with Ulla with Kariya and Saiki being the only witnesses to his death.

episodes.title: Intrigue
episodes.synopsis: AGS goes out to the public by using Haruki's death to further propagate anti-Hound operations and to promote AGS, deploying the Viper unit to a Hound safehouse before the military intervenes to arrest them instead. The unit was later blamed for massacring the Hound members who had surrendered as terrorists in a news report, forcing Saiki and the others to hide from public view as AGS security forces are mobilized to hunt them down before the police and the military apprehend them themselves. Saiki was able to escape being killed after he attacked intruding masked men, who are revealed to be military commandos.

episodes.title: Counterattack
episodes.synopsis: Ulla Chiaki, the leader of the Hound, appears on national television and accuses the Vipers of killing his fellow members. Jimmy, an AGS technician, assisted Kariya in escaping from AGS custody with the assistance of a hacker named Ageha. The Viper members gathered together in an abandoned warehouse off the grid in order to avoid being caught by AGS security forces and law enforcement. In order to find out who was responsible for framing them as terrorists, Saiki leads the Vipers in storming AGS headquarters to reacquire their Maneuver-Blades. Norma is seemingly killed to hold off VTOL jets by ramming her Maneuver-Blade against them after being wounded by Utsugi, one of the kidnappers who had been the mastermind of kidnapping her daughter.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.synopsis: Theresia and the renegade military faction were able to seize control of AGS with help from Ulla, who had been assisting them all along from the shadows. A Bugmech was launched against the public to further blame Saiki and the other Blademen as "terrorists". Saiki and the other Blademen, including Kariya, remain in hiding while receiving assistance from an unlikely ally. A covert operation was launched by renegade soldiers to kill the Blademen in a mob-owned restaurant. Gharib stays behind and offers his life on the line to assist his AGS Blademen colleagues in escaping with their lives. Rudra was later wounded and killed by military snipers after his Maneuver-Blade malfunctions.

episodes.title: Blindness
episodes.synopsis: Saiki faces off against Ulla in his custom Maneuver-Blade prototype before he was severely wounded to the point that he was blinded. Kariya assists him in guiding him to the Daiva Broadcasting building by using his World War III-era Maneuver-Blade when Ulla seriously disables his machine. Ageha hacks the controls of the Bugmechs from the military and uses them against Ulla before Jimmy was able to broadcast real footage of the Hounds being shot to death by soldiers, turning the AGS security forces against the military before they could take over the Daiva Broadcasting building. In the course of events, Ulla is killed when Saiki guns him down. Haruki appears to the public in full health and takes over AGS and changes the name to Daiva Security as the president while Fumihiko retires to tend to the the sunflowers. Kariya and Jimmy have returned as DS employees. Saiki, on the other hand, disappears from Daiva City with no one knowing where he is.

episodes.synopsis: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes.title: Earth Race
episodes.synopsis: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes.title: Medusa Mechanism

episodes.title: Sickening Yet Beautiful
episodes.synopsis: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of -- or rather, in -- the woods just yet.

episodes.title: Diamond Heart
episodes.synopsis: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

episodes.title: Stone Sanctuary
episodes.synopsis: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

episodes.title: What I Once Sought to Destroy
episodes.synopsis: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

episodes.title: Our Dr. Stone
episodes.synopsis: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

episodes.title: Until We Meet Again
episodes.synopsis: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

episodes.title: Scientist, All Alone
episodes.synopsis: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

episodes.title: Whole New World
episodes.synopsis: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

info.title: Armored Trooper Votoms: Brilliantly Shining Heresy
info.synopsis: Chirico viene risvegliato dall’ibernazione e separato da Fyana. I suoi tentativi di ritrovarla attirano l’attenzione di un Nextant, il sostituto del programma del Soldato Perfetto. Nel frattempo, sta per essere nominato il nuovo Papa, e Chirico è considerato religiosamente come 'L’Intoccabile'. Con uno dei candidati legato al Nextant, le azioni di Chirico avranno ripercussioni politiche di vasta portata.

episodes.synopsis: Decades ago, two people took drastic measures to ensure their escape from a galaxy engulfed by war. Unfortunately, the past has finally caught up to them.

episodes.title: Aregiumu
episodes.synopsis: Chirico doesn’t care what Titania wants nor that the COMPLANT is falling apart around them. Fyana is the only person who matters and Chirico won’t stop until he gets her back.

episodes.title: The Untouchable

info.title: Nozo x Kimi
info.synopsis:
Nozo x Kimi di Wakoh Honna manga spin-off di Nozoki Ana.
Kido Tatsuhiko si è trasferito a Tokyo per frequentare una scuola d'arte. Nella sua nuova stanza c'è un piccolo foro nel muro. In un primo momento non riesce a vedere nulla, ma una notte attraverso di esso scorge una ragazza... È così che la sua nuova vita ha inizio. Lo spin-off è incentrato su due studenti delle superiori Nozomi e Kimio, che abitano nello stesso complesso immobiliare proprio come i personaggi di Nozoki Ana.

episodes.title: Volume 1
episodes.synopsis: Kimio and Nozomi meets the shy Yuuki Makino, who complexes about her own body. Together they team up to help Makino break out of shell.

episodes.title: Volume 2
episodes.synopsis: A ghost is haunting the girls’ swim team, and it’s up to Nozomi and Kimio to investigate! Kimio, however, wants nothing to do with this.

episodes.title: Volume 3
episodes.synopsis: Sonoda is not happy when Nozomi beats her in a popularity contest.

episodes.title: Zero
episodes.synopsis: Zero transformed into a dragon and destroyed all the fighter planes, and escaped Black Swan Bay with Renata, heading to the east. On the way, being pursued by various forces, Zero, whose body gradually withered, chose to make a secret deal with Anjou.

episodes.title: A Night of Wild Rain
episodes.synopsis: On a stormy night of the typhoon landfall many years ago, Chu Tianjiao and his son Chu Zihang broke into Nibelungen and were pursued by Odin. Chu Tianjiao guarded the mysterious black briefcase and fought Odin and the Death Servitors alone, while Chu Zihang awakened due to the stimulation of his bloodline.

episodes.title: Birthday Cake Is the Tombstone of Youth
episodes.synopsis: On Lu Mingfei's birthday, Chu Zihang came to the class reunion, claiming to be his younger brother.

episodes.title: The King`s Chosen Servant
episodes.synopsis: Chu Zihang and Lu Mingfei figured out the perpetrator of the south station incident with the help of Nuonuo's profiling ability. After nightfall, Chu Zihang went to the Runde Towers alone to perform the mission without telling Lu Mingfei, and was attacked by the Yanling King's Chosen Servant.

episodes.title: The Dance of the Flaming Demon Sword
episodes.synopsis: Chu Zihang's mission is getting more complicated and he has less and less time to complete it.

episodes.title: The Nibelungen Plan
episodes.synopsis: At the annual meeting of the Cassell School Board, Anjou initiated the Nibelungen Plan, a project aimed at training a savior who can break through the limits of hybrids and fight against the soon-to-awaken Dragon Kings. Caesar attended the meeting as a candidate.

episodes.title: Dandelion
episodes.synopsis: Lu Mingze wishes Lu Mingfei a happy birthday, tempting him with power in exchange for his life. Lu Mingfei refuses and formally bids farewell to Chen Wenwen. Afterwards, Lu Mingfei and Chu Zihang are forced to delay their return to school, and encounter a little sister who falls from the sky.

episodes.title: Beware of Fire, Theft, and Brothers
episodes.synopsis: Xia Mi is invited to stay at a hotel with Chu Zihang and Lu Mingfei. Xia Mi and Chu Zihang share similar interests, while Lu Mingfei becomes the third wheel. Early next morning, Lu Mingfei receives a message from Lu Mingze, informing him of an important event.

episodes.title: A Feast for Dragons
episodes.synopsis: Anjou rushes to the auction with Lu Mingfei, and defeats some assassins along the way. Upon arriving at the venue, Lu Mingfei, dressed in the attire of a nouveau riche, joins this feast of hybrids, waiting for an "unexpected encounter."

episodes.title: Show Me the Money
episodes.synopsis: Lu Mingfei and the mysterious Muslim girl bid against each other for the Seven Deadly Sins, forcing him to use a temporary Yanling. He remains unaware that this entire scheme is orchestrated by the boss behind Sakatoku Mai. After the auction, the mysterious girl draws suspicion and encirclement from various factions, including the Thirteen Nobles.

episodes.title: Fall in the Atrium
episodes.synopsis: Anjou and the Thirteen Nobles part ways due to ideological differences. He takes Lu Mingfei to the theme park to meet up with Chu Zihang and Xia Mi, but encounters a roller coaster accident. Lu Mingze once again tempts Lu Mingfei to trade his life to resolve the crisis.

episodes.title: Dragon Emperor of Earth and Mountain
episodes.synopsis: Under the influence of Zero Time, Chu Zihang resolves the crisis by unleashing his Blood Rage, but is severely injured. Fortunately, he is saved by Xia Mi. Following this incident, the School Board believes that the Dragon Emperor of Earth and Mountain has awakened, and begins to suspect Chu Zihang's bloodline.

episodes.title: The Dragon Bone Cross
episodes.synopsis: Following the theme park incident, Chu Zihang and Xia Mi grow closer, while Anjou's conflict with the School Board intensifies, putting him at risk of being fired. Meanwhile, the Well of Oblivion at Cassell College, where Constantine's dragon bones are hidden, is breached by multiple intruders.

episodes.title: Battle of the Mad Dragons
episodes.synopsis: The intruders engage in a fierce battle, and Lu Mingfei seizes the opportunity to reinforce the barrier around the dragon bones with the Seven Deadly Sins. As the battle intensifies, the mysterious figure and Sakatoku Mai fight in their dragon forms. The earth shakes, and the raging flames destroy Cassell's underground complex, and erupt through the surface.

episodes.title: The Bloodline Covenant
episodes.synopsis: Lu Mingfei delivers a righteous rebuttal against the School Board's allegations at the hearing against Chu Zihang, but is ultimately overshadowed by Caesar. Although Chu Zihang's bloodline is found to be innocent, he is still rejected by the Seven Deadly Sins.

episodes.title: The Dragon Emperor`s Trail
episodes.synopsis: Chu Zihang learns the secrets of the Nibelungen Plan and must slay the Dragon Emperor to survive. Subsequently, Caesar and Chu Zihang lead their respective teams to Xinguo to carry out the dragon-slaying mission. Meanwhile, various factions begin to gather, searching for the location of the Dragon Emperor.

episodes.title: The Person Behind the Scenes
episodes.synopsis: Chu Zihang detects irregularities in the subway. Lu Mingfei, tempted by Lu Mingze, uses a temporary Yanling to fuse with him and teach some thugs a lesson. Guided by Sakatoku Mai, both Chu Zihang and Lu Mingfei are tricked into entering Nibelungen.

episodes.title: The Labyrinth
episodes.synopsis: Lu Mingfei is attacked by the Wind Devil Queen in Nibelungen. In the chaos, he gets on the subway and encounters the missing Execution Bureau specialists, kicking off his Texas Hold'em adventure. Meanwhile, Chu Zihang, tormented by inner demons, mistakes the Wind Devils for Death Servitors. At a critical moment, Xia Mi appears.

episodes.title: Your Real Name
episodes.synopsis: With Lu Mingze's help, Lu Mingfei wins the card game and finds the Dragon Emperor Fenrir, only to be invited to watch TV together. Soon after, Chu Zihang arrives. He uses Blood Rage for a second time and teams up with Xia Mi to severely injure the Dragon Emperor, but something unexpected occurs.

episodes.title: Jormungandr
episodes.synopsis: The subway tunnel collapses, and the Wind Devils invade the building. Caesar leads the hybrids into a fierce battle. Meanwhile, in the tunnel, the dying Chu Zihang burns through all his blood, unleashing Blood Rage for a third time to fight Jörmungandr. Lu Mingze reappears to tempt Lu Mingfei.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.synopsis: Fenrir consumes Jörmungandr and unleashes an apocalyptic Yanling, drawing countless Wind Devils to sacrifice themselves. Caesar uses Blood Rage and upgrades his Yanling to fight the Wind Devils. Chu Zihang uses his last ounce of strength to send Lu Mingfei away, and heads back into a battle to the death. Lu Mingfei once again stands at the crossroads of choice.

episodes.title: The Blood of Emperors Must End by the Sword
episodes.synopsis: Lu Mingze slays the Dragon Emperor with the Seven Deadly Sins, while Caesar joins forces with Parsi to eliminate the Wind Devil horde. With the Dragon Emperor's death, Nibelungen teeters on the brink of collapse. Yet there is no way for Lu Mingfei to escape, and Chu Zihang lies on the verge of death.

episodes.title: The Truth About Black Swan Bay
episodes.synopsis: Renata and Zero met in Black Swan Bay and became close friends. They vowed to escape this cruel experimental facility together. But on Christmas Eve, the night of their planned escape, Black Swan Bay was engulfed in flames. A crazed mob blocked Renata's escape route.

episodes.title: The Emperor`s Verdict
episodes.synopsis: Renata fled with the unconscious Zero in her arms, only to be bombarded by fighter jets. On the verge of death, Zero woke up, reviving her and summoning the Black Dragon to annihilate the enemy. Although the truth of history lies buried beneath the snow, Renata and Zero have been reborn under new names, and the story continues...

info.title: Roll Over and Die: I Will Fight for an Ordinary Life with My Love and Cursed Sword!
info.synopsis: Seguendo una profezia, la giovane Flamm viene aggiunta al gruppo di avventurieri formatosi appositamente per sconfiggere il re dei demoni. Tutti i membri hanno dei grandi poteri, tranne Flamm, l'unica a non possederne alcuno. La giovane, per quanto cerca di essere utile, viene ingannata e venduta a un mercante di schiavi. Rinchiusa in una gabbia, sembra essere condannata a venire divorata da alcuni zombie, come è successo a una donna prima di lei, davanti ai suoi occhi. Disperata, si accorge di come tra i resti del corpo maciullato c'è una spada. Con le sue ultime energie si avvicina per coglierla, volendo brandirla per difendersi. Flamm sembra svenire proprio al momento in cui stava per raggiungerla. Quando riprende conoscenza si accorge di averla utilizzata con maestria salvandosi. Da quel momento desidera solo vivere una vita tranquilla come avventuriera insieme a un'altra schiava incontrata in precedenza.

episodes.synopsis: What do Flum and Sara find when they return from the caves?

episodes.title: An Ordinary Life

episodes.title: Meetings and Partings

episodes.title: Budding and Withering
episodes.synopsis: The gang try to learn more about the blind girl with amnesia they suddenly find themselves with.

episodes.title: Solitude and Family

episodes.title: Truth and Reality
episodes.synopsis: Flum learns that several of her friends have disappeared and blames herself for getting them in trouble.

episodes.title: Dein and Flum
episodes.synopsis: Flum struggles to come to terms with the state she saw Ink in, and Dein shows up to complicate matters.

episodes.title: The End and the Beginning
episodes.synopsis: With Dein taken care of, Flum moves on to saving Milkit.

info.title: Getter Robo Go
info.synopsis: Nell'anno 200X il dottor Randow attacca l'umanità con dei mostri meccanici con lo scopo di conquistare il mondo. Le armi comuni sembrano essere inefficaci contro questi esseri di metallo e per questo è stata richiesta la collaborazione della NISAR, un organizzazione che ha recentemente sviluppato il Getter Robot. Nonostante sia stato progettato a fini esplorativi, il super robot si rivelerà molto utile per sconfiggere le bestie metalliche inviate dal dottor Randow, le quali, però, diventeranno via via sempre più forti, costringendo i nostri eroi ad apportare sempre più modifiche al Getter Robot.

episodes.title: Who Are You?

episodes.title: Empty Shell
episodes.synopsis: Maddened by fear and distrust, Subaru attempts to escape the watchtower... only to end up lost underground.

episodes.title: Murder Is a Habit
episodes.synopsis: Shortly after Subaru discovers Meili's corpse, Beatrice finds a book with Meili's name on it in the archive.

episodes.title: Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World
episodes.synopsis: Subaru tries desperately to convince the others that he's lost his memories, but they aren't convinced.

episodes.title: From Now On
episodes.synopsis: After waking up without his memories yet again, Subaru makes up his mind to save Meili this time.

episodes.title: Stand Up
episodes.synopsis: Subaru decides to read Reid's book of the dead in hopes of finding a way to defeat him.

episodes.title: Five Obstacles
episodes.synopsis: Subaru returns from the corridor of memories to find the tower under attack by mabeasts.

episodes.title: A Single-Minded Star
episodes.synopsis: Subaru searches for a way to deal with Reid, Gluttony, mabeasts, and a giant scorpion attacking the tower.

episodes.title: Subaru Natsuki
episodes.synopsis: With his mental state already in tatters, Subaru finds a book in the archive with his name on it.

episodes.title: Good Loser
episodes.synopsis: Subaru's two sets of memories have merged, and he leads the others in an all-out war to conquer the tower.

episodes.title: Ram
episodes.synopsis: While Emilia faces the final trial in the tower, Ram faces off against Rye.

episodes.title: Shaula / Hero

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis:
Mazinger Z vs. The Great General of Darkness (マジンガーＺ対暗黒大将軍, Majingâ Zetto tai Ankoku Daishôgun) is a 1974 Japanese mecha animated film that served as an alternative link between the Mazinger Z series and the Great Mazinger series. It basically introduces Great Mazinger to the audience, as well as his enemies from the Mikene Empire.

Dr. Hell, Mazinger Z's main enemy, has been defeated and killed in battle, and finally Kouji Kabuto and the rest of his friends can take a break from their duty of defending Japan and the world from evil.

However, during a storm after a very hot day in the beach, Boss, Mucha and Nuke have a disturbing vision of a prophet that heralds the end of the world, claiming that the dead will raise and destroy the human race, and that the General of Darkness will attack from air, sea and land. The only hope of defense is an iron fortress, Mazinger. After these words, the strange figure disappears.

info.title: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
info.synopsis: Itsuki Tomonari è uno studente delle superiori senza mezzi che rischia di perdere tutto dopo essere stato abbandonato dai genitori. La sua vita cambia quando salva Hinako Konohana, la studentessa più ammirata di una prestigiosa accademia per l'élite. Bellissima e perfetta agli occhi di tutti, Hinako nasconde però un grande segreto: è completamente incapace di gestire la vita quotidiana. Per mantenere la sua immagine impeccabile, chiede a Itsuki di diventare il suo assistente personale, occupandosi di lei lontano dagli sguardi degli altri. Vivendo e studiando insieme, i due iniziano a capirsi davvero, e quello che nasce come un semplice accordo si trasforma lentamente in un legame sempre più profondo.

info.title: Harmagedon
info.synopsis: Una terribile minaccia sta colpendo la Terra. Il malvagio Genma ha deciso, dopo aver sconfitto il suo acerrimo rivale, Vega, di attaccare la via Lattea, quindi il nostro pianeta, e distruggerlo. La principessa Luna, risvegliatasi a seguito di un incidente, viene a conoscenza della minaccia e inizia a radunare alcuni esper, gli unici in grado di opporsi a Genma. Il protagonista della storia è un ragazzo, Jo Azuma, che dovrà imparare a sfruttare al meglio i propri poteri, ampliarli e acquisire la sicurezza e la determinazione necessari per salvare il pianeta. Prima di affrontare Genma, tuttavia, gli esper se la vedranno con i suoi temibili servitori...

info.title: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet From My Cunning Fiancé
info.synopsis: A seguito di una febbre alta, all'età di 10 anni Pia Rockwell si è improvvisamente ricordata della sua vita trascorsa come studentessa universitaria in Giappone. Avendo compreso che sta interpretando il ruolo dell'antagonista in un otome game reverse-harem, ma essendo molto timida e di indole buona, ha intenzione di vivere in questo mondo usando solamente le sue conoscenze in paleontologia. Il suo obiettivo finale è diventare una cittadina comune, scavare fossili, costruire un museo e dirigerlo. Per questo Pia decide di rompere il suo fidanzamento con Rufus, il figlio del Primo Ministro, un ragazzo astuto che non la lascerà andare tanto facilmente.
